content.short: Binance.US is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange serving U.S. residents.
content.description: Binance.US is a cryptocurrency exchange for residents of the United States, created by Binance and its U.S. partner BAM Trading Services. Users can buy, sell, trade, convert and stake more than 120 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), and Cardano (ADA). This combination of asset diversity and versatile activity options positions Binance.US as a U.S.-based hub for digital assets.
